outcome: Discontinuation of the levonorgestrel releasing intrauterine system (LNG-IUS)
cohort: 201 women aged 34 years and older, without intracavitary pathology and without a future child wish, who suffered from heavy menstrual bleeding and were treated with an LNG-IUS
finding: High discontinuation rates are found in women who receive an LNG-IUS to treat heavy menstrual bleeding.
